frequency_question: What proportion of complex bilateral water treaties are fully processed, reviewed, and signed within a 132-day administrative timeline once initiated?
membership_rule: Includes formal renewals or amendments of cross-border river water-sharing treaties involving established joint river commissions; excludes entirely new treaties from scratch or treaties with zero prior framework.

skeleton: Bilateral technical review cycles (average 90 days) + Joint River Commission drafting phase (average 60 days) + Legal/Cabinet translation and approval (average 45 days). Total sequential time minimum 195 days.
multiplier: 195 days required minimum sequential path versus 132 days remaining.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic and diplomatic processing speeds for treaty renewals in these ministries change slowly over decades.
